description.value: Memorial Arena is a heritage concrete and steel sports arena built in 1948, featuring a distinctive high dual-pitched roof and a red brick entry pavilion with clerestory ribbon windows facing Victoria Street in downtown Kamloops. Designated as a historic place, it has been the home of lacrosse in Kamloops for over seven decades. Touring cyclists with an interest in mid-century civic architecture and local sports heritage may find it a worthwhile stop in the city centre.
